limit.description: Maximum whale trades to return (1–50). Default: 10.

market.description: Keyword filter on market title (case-insensitive). E.g. 'bitcoin', 'election', 'fed rate'.

min_usdc.description: Minimum USDC value per trade (size × price). Default: 500.

side.description: Filter by trade direction: BUY (taking YES/NO position) or SELL (closing/shorting). Omit for both.

Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.136 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Scans Polymarket for recent large-position trades. Returns whale entries filtered by minimum USDC value (size × entry price). Includes trader wallet, YES/NO side, USDC amount, entry price, market name, and on-chain tx hash. Use for smart-money signals, copy-trade detection, or market sentiment confirmation. Free upstream; no API keys.
